Reviewed in windows/docs/QT-6.11.3-QUALIFICATION.md. Qt Network ships, including the networking used by QML XMLHttpRequest. The advisory identifies 6.11.3 as fixed. This is a servicing review, not proof of application exploitability.

affectedVersions: from Qt 4.5.0 to Qt 6.8.10 or Qt 6.12.1 (6.11.3 is unpatched)
exceptions.mitigation: Requests::get limits each response to 1 MiB of decompressed body, a 30 s total deadline, a 15 s inactivity timeout and 5 redirects, and aborts the reply when a limit trips. This shortens how long a hostile response can consume resources. It does not bound buffers inside Qt Network, and QML XMLHttpRequest does not pass through these limits.
